faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Subsea Manifold Swivel Flange suitable for Subsea manifold piping swivel flange?
faq.a: Titanium Subsea Manifold Swivel Flange uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address oil & gas operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Subsea Manifold Swivel Flange?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Subsea Manifold Swivel Flange is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for subsea manifold piping requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Subsea Manifold Swivel Flange require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. subsea manifold piping components require Heavy-duty passivation 25% HNO3 45min per ASTM B600 for maximum chloride pitting resistance in seawater — tailored for subsea manifold piping application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Subsea Manifold Swivel Flange shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Subsea Manifold Swivel Flange includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet subsea manifold piping specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.
